_meta.status: DRAFT for Abram's review (SLA-132). Not read by any code.
_meta.source: 155 Pass 1 gif_concept values in archive/*/story_plan.json, 2026-09-02 to 2026-10-14; 152 classified, 3 left out (2 empty, 1 Tier 3 specific clip).
_meta.supply_note: supply_ids_by_label is a judgment from each verified GIF's label, not from looking at it. SLA-133's vision tagging replaces it.
_meta.fill_rank: Ordered by shortfall = target_supply - supply_estimate, then demand. target_supply = max(3, 2 x weekly demand): with a 7-day cooldown a subcategory needs at least a week of demand in stock, and twice that so the pick is not forced. SLA-133/134 fill in this order.

fields.figures: associated public figures (e.g. a celebrity tied to a player)

entity_layer.rule: Entity tags come from Giphy metadata (channel, uploader, title, slug) and visible cues (jersey number and colours, logos, on-screen text). Never from recognizing a face. An entity tag with no metadata or visible support is not written.
entity_layer.use: A secondary filter: prefer an entity match within the chosen subcategory, never pick an off-situation GIF because the entity matches.
